label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Sam Burns leads The Open
items.text: Sam Burns leads The Open Championship at Royal Birkdale with a final score of 10-under, finishing two shots ahead of Ryan Fox and Si Woo Kim at 8-under.

items.headline: Todd Clements leads Corales Puntacana
items.text: Todd Clements leads the Corales Puntacana Championship at 18-under after finishing his final round, with Ben James two shots behind at 16-under.

items.headline: McIlroy criticizes DeChambeau's penalty protest
items.text: Rory McIlroy called Bryson DeChambeau's two-stroke penalty protest at The Open "performative" and said he "held the tournament hostage," sparking fan backlash over perceived hypocrisy.
